[[Rohtu]]'s mother, Bahlya, has wandered off into [[Lahtenda Bog]]. Find her.

== Quest information ==
=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = nightfall
}}

=== Objectives ===
* Find Rohtu's mother in Lahtenda Bog.
* Return to Rohtu and tell him of his mother's fate.
 
===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 125 [[Gold]]

== Walkthrough ==
Exit [[Blacktide Den]] and head south to find Bahlya's corpse surrounded by a group of [[Corsair]]s. Return to Rohtu and tell him of his mother's fate.

== NPCs ==
* {{x}} 10 Bahlya (corpse)

== Dialogue ==

=== Initial dialogue ===
'''Rohtu'''
: ''"Can you help me find my '''mother'''?  Please?  Ever since my father died last year in a quarry accident, she hasn't been well.  She waited for him at home, with dinner on the table, for weeks.  Then, she began wandering off searching for him, convinced he got lost on his way home.  I usually find her before she gets too far, but she must have left home while I worked the mine yesterday.  I looked everywhere, but now I think she must have wandered into '''Lahtenda Bog'''.  That's a dangerous area and I'm no warrior.  Please, [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspear]], find my sick mother '''Bahlya''' and bring her back to me."''
{{ offer dialog
| accept = Of course.  I shall hurry before it is too late.
| decline = I am sorry.  If she is in the bog, it may be too late.
| ask = Quickly!  You must find my sick '''mother'''.  She won't last long by herself in '''Lahtenda Bog'''. }}

=== Reward dialogue ===
'''Rohtu'''
: ''"Killed?  By corsairs?  No!  I can't believe it!  Are you sure?  No.  No.  No.  Had I but been more diligent watching her..."''

== Notes ==
* You can also do the quest [[Crypt-ology]] while working on this quest.
